findings.problem: The hint rules out 'de verdad' and 'en serio', but 'verdaderamente' is also one common word ending in -mente that means 'really', so the prompt still has two right answers.
findings.fix: hint: one word ending in -mente, built on the Spanish word for 'real' (not verdaderamente)

back.example: Do you really want to go to the party?

note: In casual speech Latin Americans often say 'de verdad' or 'en serio' for 'really?', so the editor could mention this in a later card or a note on the card.
